intelligence.title: Intelligence Check
intelligence.description: Runs the configured intelligence checks on a schedule and keeps the latest 10 runs per channel.
intelligence.history.notConfigured: No channel is configured yet. Add one under Settings.
intelligence.history.empty: No runs recorded for this channel yet.
intelligence.history.previewAfterFailure: Automatic scoring failed. Please review the output for degradation yourself.
The HTML was generated, but the manxue.ai scoring call failed.
intelligence.settings.title: Check settings
intelligence.settings.description: Pick an API key, model and check per channel; each key is configured on its own row.
intelligence.settings.enabledHint: When off, only the manual run stays available.
intelligence.settings.intervalHint: Every run covers all configured channels and takes minutes, so watch your upstream quota.
intelligence.settings.noTargets: No channel configured yet. Use Add channel.
intelligence.settings.targetsHint: Each configured target produces one result: pelican draws a web page, candy answers a question, usually 2-12 minutes per run.
intelligence.settings.timeoutHint: Per-run timeout in minutes. Leave empty for the default 12 minutes; raise it for a very slow upstream, up to 20 minutes.
intelligence.messages.started: Started {{count}} test(s); they run in batches and appear as they finish
intelligence.history.manual.label: Manual: {{verdict}}
intelligence.history.verdictFilter.label: Verdict
intelligence.runAllTargetsHint: Runs every configured channel once; this takes several minutes
intelligence.settings.addDialog.title: Add a test channel
intelligence.settings.addDialog.descript: Pick the channel, API key, model and check; the target joins the configuration on confirm.
intelligence.settings.addDialog.noFreeKe: Every key of this channel is already configured.
intelligence.settings.scheduleDescriptio: Decides when the intelligence check runs on its own.
intelligence.settings.disableDegradedKey: Disable a key when it is degraded

Scheduled runs only: a key judged degraded is disabled, and re-enabled once a later run judges it normal. Disabling also removes the key from live traffic, so enable with care. Keys you disabled by hand are never re-enabled automatically.
intelligence.settings.dragHint: Drag the handle to reorder the keys within a channel.
